stage0.trace_index_correction: old_saved_face_quadrature_trace.npz face_ids is the node index, not a physical face ID. old_face_node_index_provenance_v2.npz supplies explicit node_index and owner_pair_group_index and bookkeeping_candidate_segment_index; ambiguous matches are not certified original face IDs.
stage0.scope:
Postprocess actual stored quadrature/dm and face-inventory reproduction.
No nonlinear density fit, RHS, geometry completion or evolution rerun.
stage0.limits: Stored actual quadrature/dm/face inventory reproduction; original vertex byte identity cannot be proved because no original vertex array was stored. Pair-weight reproduction does not prove physical face uniqueness; duplicate segments and ambiguous matching retained. Weight diagnostic scale does not certify upstream geometry.
